intent: Given Diagnosis's two-cause read of the Q3 contraction, what's the sequenced recovery pathway?

prior_session_intent.intent_text: Did we diagnose the Q3 revenue contraction correctly, or are we pattern-matching the checkout regression?
prior_session_intent.diagnostic_read: Two independent causes — SDK regression on conversion + session-acquisition decline starting earlier. 62% Likely (corpus-tier).

user_turns.text: We need a recovery plan that addresses both causes — not just the SDK fix.
Budget: 1 senior eng + 2 ops people for the next 12 weeks. Constraint: campaign budget capped at 80k.
Most-recent comparable: a peer recovered MoM index in ~8 weeks via parallel SDK + reactivation tracks.
Sequence question: which lands first — checkout fix or reactivation campaign? Or both in parallel?
If we go parallel we burn team capacity on coordination; if sequential we lose 3-4 weeks. Trade-off.
Parallel works only if the checkout fix doesn't require reactivation-team review — they're independent enough.

attached_docs.name: Peer recovery case — same SDK regression

comparables.name: Peer A — parallel recovery in 8 weeks
comparables.diagnosis_summary: SDK fix + reactivation ran in parallel; recovered MoM index in 8 weeks.

output.framing_note: Frame inherited from Diagnosis; Develop Strategy converges to recovery sequencing.

hypotheses: Reactivation first to recover sessions, SDK after.

output.triangulation_note: Peer comparable supports parallel; team capacity constraint makes parallel feasible only if scopes are clean.

tensions.description: Speed-to-recovery (parallel) vs team-capacity-strain (parallel adds coordination overhead).
evidence: Team capacity 1 eng + 2 ops constrains coordination overhead.

claims.text: Parallel-tracks recovery sequenced Days 0-30 (SDK fix lands) → 0-60 (reactivation campaign launches week 3 in parallel) → 30-180 (stabilisation). 8-10 week recovery target.
claims.confidence_rationale: Peer comparable supports parallel; team capacity feasibility OK.

claims.text: Sequential — SDK first then reactivation. 11-13 week recovery target.
claims.confidence_rationale: Lower coordination overhead but loses 3-4 weeks.

claims.text: Reactivation-first inversion. 14-16 week recovery; not preferred.
claims.confidence_rationale: Reverses the natural diagnostic priority; comparable counter-signals.

output.reflection_question: What does this NOT cover that you wish it did?
output.user_response: It doesn't cover the third Q4 risk — what if a NEW regression lands during recovery?

output.reflection_question: What would have to be true for this pathway to be wrong?
output.user_response: If the checkout fix requires reactivation-team review, parallel breaks. The independence assumption is load-bearing.
output.interpretation: User defines a falsification test on the parallelism assumption.

output.reflection_question: What's the question you weren't ready to ask?
output.user_response: Whether the 'session decline' Diagnosis surfaced is itself a multi-cause signal that needs separate diagnosis.
output.interpretation: User opens a nested-Diagnosis path the recovery pathway doesn't address.

synthesis.body:
## Recovery pathway

Parallel tracks land the 8-10 week recovery target with the narrowest team-capacity strain. SDK fix in weeks 0-3 (eng owner); reactivation campaign launches week 3 (ops owner). Stabilisation phase begins week 8.

## Conditional logic

If checkout fix dependencies on reactivation-team review surface in week 1 standup, fall back to Sequential (SDK then reactivation) — adds 3-4 weeks but removes coordination risk.

recommendations.heading: Land checkout SDK fix in weeks 0-3 (eng owner)
recommendations.body: Could ship checkout SDK fix in weeks 0-3 with the senior eng as owner. Exit gate: weekly active sessions index ≥ 95.

recommendations.heading: Launch reactivation campaign week 3 (ops owners) in parallel
recommendations.body: Would launch reactivation campaign in parallel from week 3. Exit gate: revenue index ≥ 95 by week 8.

recommendations.heading: Phase 3 stabilisation begins week 8
recommendations.body: Would begin stabilisation phase week 8 if both phase exits land. Target: revenue index ≥ 100 by week 12.
